sentences.text: It is the contention of the learned counsel for the applicants that the name of the applicants does not appear in the first information report to be the persons from whose custody the contraband articles are seized.

3. Learned APP opposed the application by contending that during the course of the investigation name of the applicants have revealed as supplier of the contraband articles and hence, they are not entitled for anticipatory bail.
Learned APP informed the Court that the present applicants are found involved in similar crime earlier and they are enlarged on bail.
4. Merely because names of applicants do not appear in First Information Report, they are not entitled to get protection from arrest.
During investigation their involvement is seen in this crime.

Applicants are on bail in similar offence earlier and which makes it clear that the applicants are misusing the liberty granted by the Court and taking disadvantage of the same to commit further crimes.
Only for this reason applicants are not entitled for any protection from arrest.
